title: Microflow Operator — personal idea canvas
content:
TL;DR:
A lightweight per-request orchestration layer ("microflow operator") that stitches small inference building blocks (prompt transforms, cheap rerankers, short-circuit heuristics, tool calls) into compact pipelines to reduce average token cost while meeting latency/quality SLOs.

Why bother / problem framing:
- Customers have diverse needs: some requests only need cheap extraction or a single-shot transform; others need full LLM generation. Today we either run full model or do brittle client-side hacks.
- Inefficient: many tokens and GPU time are spent on requests that could be resolved earlier with inexpensive ops (rules, embeddings match, light LMs).
- Hard to compose: teams want to mix small specialized components (e.g., extraction models, rerank, canonicalizers) without heavy infra changes.

High-level idea:
- Define a tiny DSL (json-y) for microflows: sequence of steps with conditional branching, short-circuiting, and cost/latency budgets per request.
- Operator runs server-side inside Hosted and Dedicated; private customers get a config file for Private.
- Integrations: local fast LMs (distil), embeddings store check, regex/heuristic nodes, full LLM nodes, tool-call nodes, cached prefix reuse.

Goals / success metrics (first 3 months):
- 15–30% reduction in tokens billed on targeted workloads (simple QA, form-filling).
- No more than +25ms P50 latency on happy-path compared to baseline (for short-circuit cases latency should be better).
- Developer feedback: 80% of early alpha users can express common flows with <10 lines of DSL.

User personas and example flows:
1) Product-support tab (SaaS company):
  - User story: "When a user asks for a billing question, check embeddings for similar KB answers; if high-confidence match, return short answer; else run LLM with template."
  - Acceptance: >=90% precision on short-circuit matches, 30% cost saving on support queries.
2) Invoice parser:
  - Story: "Try light OCR-format parser + rule-based money extraction; if missing fields, escalate to extraction LM; else return structured JSON."
3) Assistant composer (developer):
  - Story: "Compose reranker -> LLM with function call -> sanitize outputs. I want per-step timeouts and fallbacks."

Microflow DSL sketch (very rough):
- steps: [{id, type, engine, params, timeout_ms, on_fail}]
- conditionals: if(step.result.confidence > 0.85) short_circuit -> return(step.result)
- budgets: max_tokens_total, max_ms_total, prefer_low_cost:true

Example snippet:
{
  "steps": [
    {"id":"kb_check","type":"embeddings-lookup","engine":"local-embed-v1","threshold":0.9},
    {"id":"rank","type":"reranker","engine":"cheap-rank-v1"},
    {"id":"gen","type":"llm","engine":"redwood-medium","max_tokens":120}
  ],
  "flow_conditions": [
    {"if":"kb_check.similarity >= 0.9","then":"return kb_check.answer"}
  ]
}

Operational concerns / non-functional:
- Observability: per-step traces, token counts, time, fallback reasons. Hook into Console traces and cost dashboards.
- Safety: ensure short-circuits don't leak PII; step-level redaction rules.
- Isolation: per-customer microflow configs; sandbox steps that run untrusted code only in Dedicated/Private.
- Caching: step-level cache keys + prefix/KV reuse.

Design tradeoffs / open questions:
- Where does orchestration live? In the inference runtime (C++) for latency vs a lightweight nodejs controller for agility.
- DSL complexity: keep small for adoption vs expressiveness for complex flows.
- Billing model: charge per-step tokens? per-flow execution? hybrid. Need legal + finance input.

Experiment plan (alpha):
- 2-week runway: implement prototype in node sidecar for hosted; wire embeddings store and a distil LM; add trace events.
- Select 3 customer-like workloads (support; invoices; search-fallback) and run A/B on small traffic slice.
- Measure token delta, latency, and user-perceived accuracy (small eval set).

Rollout & productization notes:
- MVP: DSL + node sidecar + SDK + console traces. Allow users to opt-in by route.
- v1: Move hot-path short-circuit execution into runtime for latency-sensitive paths; add UI to author microflows in Console.
- Gateway features: route-level quotas, per-step timeouts & fallbacks, canary toggles.

Next steps / TODOs (me):
- Draft quick demo flow for support use case (deadline: 2025-11-22).
- Ping infra to discuss embedding-store QPS and cache TTLs (Arun).
- Mock up Console authoring UX (Maya).
- Schedule 30-min sync with legal on billing model implications.

Notes to self / loose thoughts:
- Could be a low-friction replacement for customer-side prefilters that often cause drift and duplication.
- Consider marketplace of community microflows (sanitized) later.
- Maybe leverage Optimize recommendations to suggest where a microflow short-circuit would be beneficial based on token telemetry.

References / similar patterns to read:
- internal: "prefetch-priming-profiles" notes (see drive)
- external: AWS Step Functions for long-running tasks (but heavier), Cloudflare Workers for edge execution pattern.

Questions to resolve in next meeting:
- Is there appetite to expose step runtimes as billable metrics?
- Tolerance for per-request orchestration added CPU overhead?
- Which teams want early access (CS, Platform, Hosting)?

End.
